test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'SAMPLE' is written as ‘RYJLGY’ and ‘MAPLE’ is written as ’LYMHZ’. How will 'PEOPLE' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

'SAMPLE' is written as 'RYJLGY'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f407f96dc739993248de6ed6c51162d21cb4257b85a0fbd3f153bfde413bc362.png] 

And,

'MAPLE' is written as 'LYMHZ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10e3d8c18269ae1af5b3ed239cd5c3d070832fddca2d42fe6bd42b068e8e0661.png] 

Similarly,

'PEOPLE' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db33a5c9b1a09b5ceeaab36bd4bc1586e53d30e4958446d3a1d602e98fa28006.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"OCLLGY".**
